note: Phrases that soften a claim. Data rather than code so that adding one is a data change and a test, per ART-08. Ordered longest first so that 'a little bit' is matched before 'a bit'.

excluded.just: Temporal and quantifying far more often than hedging: 'just one call' is precise. Counting it would make the measurement noise.
excluded.like: Already excluded from fillers for the same reason: a filler sometimes and content the rest of the time.
excluded.really: An intensifier, not a softener. It strengthens the claim it sits in front of.
